description: VMP api-node — Deno Deploy via linked GitHub repository; Postgres via DATABASE_URL.
notes: Deno Deploy builds from the linked repo on every push (PR previews and production on main). Install/build/runtime are defined in packages/api-node/deno.json (lean install via scripts/deno-deploy-install.mjs — do not use root npm ci; the monorepo lockfile includes optional native platform packages that fail npm ci on Linux). PR gate: npm run verify:api-node in ci.yml. Deploy gate: Deno Deploy build status on the PR.
